## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.6 improves development workflows, source-backed topic maintenance, and Manager memory previews.

### Development workflows that travel with Threadnote

Threadnote now ships `dev-spec`, `dev-plan`, `dev-cycle` and `watch-pr` as managed workflows for supported Codex and Cursor hosts. Setup can install them by default, and `threadnote dev-skills` can list, preview, install, inspect, update or remove a selected host and scope.

Manager adds a Development workflows page for reviewing destinations, installed generations, readiness and shared consumers before applying a change. Threadnote updates refresh enabled workflow installations while preserving edited, inaccessible or unowned files for review. Development workflow setup also handles changing Windows paths more reliably.

### Clearer topic maintenance

Source-backed topic review separates factual updates from policy conflicts and keeps protected history intact. Generation progress and the recommended action are clearer. After acceptance, Manager confirms the saved update, closes the dialog and clears resolved attention; resolution persists after reload.

Drafts use the current generation settings and are regenerated when those settings change.

### Diagrams in memory previews

Manager renders fenced Mermaid diagrams in memory previews, so architecture and process diagrams can be read alongside the memory that contains them.
